arguments.sql:
WITH eligible_leagues AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT M.XCL_008 AS league_id
  FROM Match M
  WHERE SUBSTRING(M.XCL_011, 1, 7) BETWEEN '2008-08' AND '2008-10'
),
league_draw_stats AS (
  SELECT
    M.XCL_008 AS league_id,
    L.XCL_005 AS league_name,
    COUNT(*) AS total_matches,
    SUM(CASE WHEN M.XCL_015 = M.XCL_016 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS draw_matches
  FROM Match M
  INNER JOIN League L ON M.XCL_008 = L.XCL_003
  WHERE M.XCL_009 = '2008/2009'
  GROUP BY M.XCL_008, L.XCL_005
)
SELECT LDS.league_name
FROM league_draw_stats LDS
INNER JOIN eligible_leagues EL ON LDS.league_id = EL.league_id
ORDER BY (LDS.draw_matches * 1.0 / LDS.total_matches) DESC
LIMIT 1
